Preserve the two characters' identities, faces, hair and costumes exactly. New scene: inside the grand royal library in late afternoon, at a wide arched window with golden light, Serin sits at a window-side reading table absorbed in an open book, a purple bookmark resting beside her hand. Ria has just arrived and stops a few steps away in gentle surprise, one hand lifted, recognizing her dormitory roommate in this unexpected place. Tall bookshelves and warm lamps behind, violet-tinted sky through the window. Both faces clearly visible in the upper two thirds of the frame, intimate eye-level composition. No text, no letters on book spines, no UI, labels, watermark, speech bubbles or other characters.
